candidate_relations.reason: Preeclampsia is a maternal comorbidity, not twin anemia-polycythemia sequence.
A genetic cause of growth restriction was considered; CMA was normal and does not name TAPS.
Selective IUGR explains discordance in twin 2 size but is a different twin complication from TAPS, which is defined by MCA-PSV discordance.
Chronic intertwin transfusion syndrome is a parent transfusion concept missing TAPS specificity.
Twin-twin transfusion syndrome requires amniotic-fluid discordance; later both twins had normal fluid with MCA-PSV discordance, which is TAPS not TTTS.
Twin anemia polycythemia sequence matches the reference diagnosis.
Chronic hypertension is not described as the fetal diagnosis.
Tetralogy of Fallot is an associated anomaly in twin 2, not TAPS.

case_quality_flags: TAPS is typically a monochorionic diagnosis; this pregnancy was labeled dichorionic, which is atypical for the reference
